sentence_stem: The committee rejected the proposal; nevertheless,
correct_completion: it agreed to reconsider the matter next year.
full_sentence: The committee rejected the proposal; nevertheless, it agreed to reconsider the matter next year.
acceptable_variants: it still agreed to revisit the decision later.
it decided to reopen the discussion.

options.text: consequently, the budget was cut in half.
options.why_wrong: 'Consequently' signals a result. 'Nevertheless' signals that the next part goes against what was expected after the rejection.

options.text: it agreed to reconsider the matter next year.
the members were all in the same room.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail but does not complete the logical contrast opened by 'nevertheless'.

options.text: similarly, the chairman had supported it.
options.why_wrong: 'Similarly' signals similarity, not the contrast expected after 'nevertheless' following a rejection.

grammar_focus: Contrastive linking with 'nevertheless' after a semicolon
explanation: 'Nevertheless' introduces a clause that goes against what the first clause leads us to expect. Learners at this level should choose a continuation that reverses the expected outcome, not one that adds a result or a similar point.
translation: Komite teklifi reddetti; buna rağmen, önümüzdeki yıl konuyu yeniden görüşmeyi kabul etti.
